title: Dataset Quality & Deduplication Engine
description: Clean and deduplicate JSON records or an Apify dataset. Charged per input row analyzed. Free plans: up to 100 input rows per run.

records.title: Records
records.description: Paste JSON objects or use datasetId.

datasetId.title: Or Apify dataset ID/name
datasetId.description: Read records from an accessible Apify dataset when pasted records are absent.

keyFields.title: Duplicate key fields
keyFields.description: Leave empty to compare all non-ignored fields.

ignoreFields.title: Fields ignored for duplicates
ignoreFields.description: Exclude volatile fields such as timestamps from duplicate signatures.

normalizeCase.title: Normalize text case
normalizeCase.description: Lowercase non-URL strings before duplicate comparison.

trimWhitespace.title: Normalize whitespace
trimWhitespace.description: Trim strings and collapse repeated whitespace before analysis.

normalizeUrls.title: Normalize URLs
normalizeUrls.description: Removes fragments and common tracking parameters; sorts remaining query parameters.

removeEmptyStrings.title: Convert empty strings to null
removeEmptyStrings.description: Represent blank text consistently as null in cleaned rows.

validateEmailFormat.title: Validate email format
validateEmailFormat.description: Syntax only. No mailbox lookup, enrichment, or harvesting.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: Choose whether the dataset includes cleaned rows, detailed issue rows, or only the summary.

maxRows.title: Maximum rows
maxRows.description: Hard cap on input records analyzed in one run.

maxComparisons.title: Maximum fuzzy comparisons
maxComparisons.description: Hard compute cap; exact duplicate detection continues after the cap.
